retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the robbery of a Banco Espírito Santo branch at Campolide on 7 August 2008. The atlas holds the bank as an actor and holds its resolution in 2014, and neither has anything to do with a branch robbery; wiring one to the other would be a pun on the name rather than an argument.
